cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 4.0)
project(VerilogDevTemplate CXX)

# cpp23 becuase modern
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# generate compile_commands.json (clangd)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

# dont use modules (causes issues with autogenerated verilator headers)
set(CMAKE_CXX_SCAN_FOR_MODULES OFF)

find_package(verilator REQUIRED)


include(FetchContent)

# use magic enum (for auto enum to string for test benches using auto generated system verilog enums)
FetchContent_Declare(
    magic_enum
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/Neargye/magic_enum.git
    GIT_TAG        v0.9.8 
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(magic_enum)

# function to create test bench programs
function(add_hardware_test TARGET_NAME TOP_MODULE CPP_TB VERILOG_SOURCES VERILOG_INCLUDES)
    # Create the executable
    add_executable(${TARGET_NAME} ${CPP_TB})
    target_include_directories(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE sim/include)

    # Run Verilator
    verilate(${TARGET_NAME}
        PREFIX V${TOP_MODULE}
        SOURCES ${VERILOG_SOURCES}
        TOP_MODULE ${TOP_MODULE}
        INCLUDE_DIRS ${VERILOG_INCLUDES}     # Let Verilator handle the include paths cleanly
        VERILATOR_ARGS "-Wall"
    )

    target_link_libraries(${TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE magic_enum::magic_enum)
endfunction()

# ALU TESTBENCH
set(ALU_SOURCES "src/alu/alu.sv" "src/alu/alu_defs.sv")
set(ALU_INCLUDES "src/alu")
add_hardware_test(Vsim_alu alu "sim/src/test/tb_alu.cpp" "${ALU_SOURCES}" "${ALU_INCLUDES}")
